games.name: NORTHWIND
games.desc:
NORTHWIND is a roleplay survival adventure game centered around the colonization of Quebec. This world bears an expansive, beautiful landscape with magnificent mountains, rivers, caves, and settlements for you to explore. Its resources are at your disposal for however you see fit; discover cooking, hunting, smithing, and take part in many more professions to expand your expertise. Earn pounds by completing vendor quests, hunting criminals for their bounty, trading with others, or by enlisting and rising through the ranks of the redcoat militia. How you take on the frontier is entirely up to you.





Tags: Survival, Hunting, PVP, Factions, House Building

Anomic is set in 1992.
